title: Fight Pool
description: Fight Pool quite literally weaponizes the Pool.
body:
## Discription
Fight Pool adds items that literally weaponize the pool.

## Features
- **Sunscreen:** If walked on it causes the player to be pushed backwards a bit.
- **Beach Bomb:** If it touches any entity or block it explodes causing a non-destructive explosion. 
- **Pool Noodles:** A very weak and easy weapon to craft, used for the laughs.
- **Pool Floaty:** When used on a hostile entity it stuns them for 5 seconds.
